project.name: Connascence Fixture
project.description:
Jawata-owned fixture for Sprint 28d: the PROOF OF LIFE corpus for the `coupling` detector, which flags a package whose cross-boundary connascence weight sits in the top decile of the corpus AND above its median. A quantile needs a POPULATION, so this fixture is deliberately ten packages wide with a lopsided distribution:
com.example.hub — the outlier. Every one of its 9 connascence sites crosses the package boundary, including two Connascence-of-Position call sites (3-arg and 2-arg). Cross-boundary weight 19. com.example.ledger — moderate: 4 cross-boundary sites, weight 6. com.example.model — the GOOD pole. High connascence, all of it WITHIN the package; cross-boundary weight 0, and 2 dependents. Must NOT be flagged. com.example.leaf.a..g — seven self-contained packages, weight 0, so the corpus has a real distribution to rank against (median 0, 90th-percentile cut 6).
Expected with the default 90th percentile: exactly TWO findings — com.example.hub (weight 19) then com.example.ledger (weight 6). Nothing outside this project may be added to it: the numbers above are an order statistic of exactly these files.
